page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head centred at top; page number at top right; catchword "aut" at bottom right.

main_text.p: effere fibi non necessarium. Repetere leo cum amicis non aliquo rifúq; jocó-ue, quantum fudárit, ut tandem inep-iret magis, vir alias fane non inerudi-is, Paulus Cortefius: Qui dum, post homam & Scotum & complures alios editatur in quatuor libros Sententia-m commentarios, pertæfus sc. voces Scholis receptas ut minùs Ciceroni-nas, pro Ecclefia ( delicias hominis!) aluit ubique Senatum dicere, pro Le-ibus Ecclefiasticis Senatus-Consulta, ro Prædestinatione Prafignationem, ro Sacerdotum Ordinatione Initiati-nem, pro Angelis Genios, pro Epi-copis Flamines,& alia passim ad eun-em modum plurima. Quo eodem norbo laborasse invenio & alios quos-lam, ut Petrum Bembum Cardinalem, & Sebastianum Castalionem: sed eos & aucos admodum, & aliquanto tempe-ratiús. At nobis non libet, nobis non icet esse tàm difertis. Oratori condo-abitur, imò laudi erit, si sit verborum aulò diligentior: cujus inter virtutes st, non apte modò & dilucide, sed e-iam pure & ornate dicere; quémque on dedecebit floridiús quandoque & picturatiús incedere. Ast Philosophum, aut

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letter or two of many lines are cut off; those lines are given as far as they are visible (e.g. "leo", "homam", "editatur", "norbo"). "norbo" on the line "[?]norbo laborasse" is probably "morbo" but is not clearly legible. A small stray mark (a dot) stands in the right margin beside "non" on the line "At nobis non libet"; it is not a note. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept.
